mapper.select: SELECT gb.guestbook_id AS guestBookId, gb.guestbook_content AS guestBookContent, gb.written_at AS writtenAt, gb.guestbook_minihome_id AS guestBookMiniHomeId, gb.guestbook_writer_id AS guestBookWriterId, writer.nickname AS nickname, writer.profile_photo_path AS profilePhotoPath FROM guestbook AS gb INNER JOIN user AS owner ON owner.user_id = gb.guestbook_minihome_id -- 미니홈피 주인 INNER JOIN user AS writer ON writer.user_id = gb.guestbook_writer_id -- 방명록S작성자 WHERE owner.login_id = #{miniHomeOwnerLoginId} ORDER BY gb.written_at DESC;
